Provide visual target angle/direction preserving existing nearest-target choice; clockwise/canvas angle convention and complete occlusion policy.
Confirm external shadows/status/hit masks/health/badges/effects ownership; root-relative bounds API for layer placement.
Supply shared brown/sage/coral/honey/cream tokens and source-scale outline spec.
UI requests static neutral 48/64/96px icon outputs from the same approved body; no separate generic icon.
